I replied to Dana in her #north-random thread. I noted that the Osprey rollout deadline at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 26 August, and as she asked, I didn't do anything else.

The date looks wrong, though. The simulation clock shows today is 14 October 2026, so 26 August this year has already passed. I asked her whether she meant 26 August 2027 or a different date.
